title: DRAKAN FINAL BOSS FIGHT GUIDE (OSRS)
summary: A guide to Draken (Loerniel Draken), the final boss of the Grandmaster quest Blood Moon Rises, which Gnomonkey calls the hardest quest boss in the game. It covers the quest-specific potions, the basic punch dodges, the blood portal, lightning and final phases, and notes the fight is forgiving because of free healing supplies.

outline.text: Basic combat mechanics: dodging the jabs and burst attacks

claims.text: Gnomonkey considers Loerniel Draken, the final boss of Blood Moon Rises, the hardest quest boss in the entire game, and says many people are struggling with him.
At the start of the Draken fight he throws rapid spear jabs and the arrows telegraph the direction to dodge; you dodge in the opposite direction of the one forecast (for example left, right, left).
Draken flashes red as the cue to start clicking through the dodges rapidly for his basic punch attack.
When Draken does punches ending in a giant burst of energy into himself, you click on him to move forward through the big ring AoE instead of dodging backwards.

Draken's special stab animation (rearing back) is an AoE in front of and behind him, so you dodge to the side; he always throws a jab afterwards, and Gnomonkey thinks later in the fight he can do two.
Draken's second special AoE curls the spear behind him in a sweeping arc around him, with the area directly behind him safe, so you run around behind him to dodge it.
Gnomonkey thinks Draken only starts using his two special AoE attacks below about 80% health.
Below roughly 70% health, Draken dashes away and spawns blood portals that send out waves.

After the portal phase Draken pops back into the arena with four hit splats on him as he drains his own blood to fire at you; you must immediately put on Protect from Magic, as this is basically the only one-shot mechanic in the fight.
Gnomonkey says he died the first time to Draken's blood-drain magic attack because he did not pray mage in time.

If you dodge the series of punches after the blood-drain attack perfectly (left, right, left), Draken takes a massive hit splat (155 in the footage) and the portals disappear immediately; if you mess up a punch you do not get the splat and must do another set of waves.

Later in the fight Draken occasionally throws in a mage attack, visible as blood behind him; you have about two or three ticks to react and switch on Protect from Magic to block it. Gnomonkey believes it heals Draken if it hits you.
After about 800 health has been chunked from Draken, he sweeps away and lightning strikes start spawning blood pools on the ground.

In the lightning phase Draken does a sweep with a red flash then a dash towards you; since he always sweeps in a 90-degree arc out of the way, you can dodge by clicking in the direction you immediately see him on your screen.
In the lightning phase you can get two perfect punish sets (a smaller splat, 80 in the footage) because Draken does the sweep attack twice, so a perfect run finishes the fight faster.
Below 10% health, which Gnomonkey says is basically nothing, you can pretty much face-tank the whole phase and just spam brews while Draken throws very fast rapid jabs.
Gnomonkey says you will likely have at least 8 brews by the final phase and should be ready to spam them.

Draken does not care if blood is in your way and will make you dash right into it; the blood takes your prayer off and does about 20 damage per game tick, so rotate around the boss between attacks to avoid being forced into blood.

An alternative dodge Gnomonkey credits to MMORPG: if you panic run backwards you are out of the AoE, Draken only steps forward one tile, and you can dodge the next sweep if it goes in the correct direction.
You cannot refight Draken after stepping out of the arena.
For the blood wave attack and Draken's swoop dashes, dodge in straight cardinal lines only, with no diagonal steps, because diagonal movement may stop him from dashing.
Blood Moon Rises is a new Grandmaster quest whose final boss is Loerniel Draken.
The Blood Moon Rises quest unlocks the Maggot King, which Gnomonkey had just put up a separate guide on.
Gnomonkey describes the Draken fight as very forgiving: it lets you bring in a lot of free healing supplies from the chest and death fees mean failing costs little.
Gnomonkey tells viewers who have lost their quest cape to go get it back by beating Draken.

For the Draken fight you get quest-specific potions: a super combat, brews (the colors line up), and a red potion at the bottom that is an ambrosia; single-dose ambrosias from Tombs of Amascut can also be brought.
The quest-specific brews only drain a single combat stat by one level, unlike a normal brew, so you can spam them during the Draken fight.
Gnomonkey recommends pre-potting the quest brews before the Draken fight to get your overheal going.
Pre-potting a quest-specific restore before the Draken fight also gives prayer regeneration through the fight.
Gnomonkey says to bring an Efaritay's aid (a silver ring with a red stone) to the Draken fight; he forgot to mention it at the start.
